back: Chemical reactions in cells that break down nutrient molecules to release energy without using oxygen.

front: Why does anaerobic respiration release less energy per glucose?
back: Glucose is only partly broken down; the products (ethanol or lactic acid) still contain much energy.

notes: ZIMSEC: plant cells short of oxygen do the same.

Word equation for anaerobic respiration in muscles?

back: The extra oxygen needed after vigorous exercise to break down the lactic acid that built up.

front: How is the oxygen debt repaid?
back: Fast heart rate carries lactic acid to the liver; deep, fast breathing supplies oxygen; the liver breaks lactic acid down aerobically.

front: What causes muscle fatigue during vigorous exercise?
back: Lactic acid from anaerobic respiration builds up in the muscles.

front: Uses of anaerobic respiration by yeast?
back: Baking (carbon dioxide makes dough rise), brewing (alcohol) and biofuel (ethanol).

front: Aerobic vs anaerobic respiration: two key differences?
back: Aerobic uses oxygen and releases much more energy; anaerobic needs no oxygen and makes lactic acid or ethanol.
